title: Cute
text: Cute. I needed a table for a guest bedroom, this fit the bill. Reasonably priced and works great for a nightstand. Easy to assemble, all you have to do is attach the legs.

product_metadata.title: Decor Therapy Simplify End Table with Shelf, Antique White
features: Constructed of MDF and solid wood
description: The Simplify End Table is a modern take on a classically designed table. Available in an variety of colors to ensure you have the ideal shade to bring your house to life. Available in a variety of finishes so you can find the look that best suits your space. Pair this transitional side table with an arm chair, add a decorative accent and garnish with a beautiful table lamp for instantaneous, magazine-worthy style. Keep your most read books and magazines within reach on the useful bottom shelf. Solids and MDF construction ensure long lasting durability, sure to handle your busy family's storage needs. Easy to assemble. Table measures 19.5x15.75x24"
